source.source_title: House of the woods: A forest trilogy
source.why_this_clip: Close shot of tall green reed grass filling the frame while the camera drifts across it; the blades barely move on their own. This 2 s stretch sits after the blurred cattail passes out of frame and before the blackbird enters at the top at 12.5 s; cuts.json shows no spikes, and the earlier part of the clip is upside-down reeds joined by a dissolve around 4 to 5 s.
